rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes adding a reactive element (yttrium) to form oxide dispersoids, while the target paper added chromium to form a Laves phase. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies high-temperature mechanical testing under jet-turbine conditions, whereas the target paper performed room-temperature compression testing. These are contradictory regimes.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes dispersion strengthening by oxide nanoprecipitates, while the target paper describes a dual mechanism of solid solution hardening and crack hindrance by a reticulated Laves phase. These are different classes of mechanism.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts improved high-temperature strength and creep resistance, while the target paper reports concurrent increases in room-temperature yield strength and fracture strain. The properties and conditions differ.
